message_spans.text:
Bug report: Streamlit 1.49.0, Python 3.12, Chrome on Windows, local app. st.write_stream sometimes displays the final word twice. My generator logs each yielded chunk once; concatenating those chunks outside Streamlit gives the expected string. I already tested with no manual rerun and a fresh browser. Code:
```python
def chunks():
    yield "north "
    yield "star"
st.write_stream(chunks())
```
I need one specific next diagnostic, not a confirmed cause.
